content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-006 Systemd Unit Written With Restart Always And Tmp ExecStart) AND (BIOC(CDR-006 Systemd Daemon-Reload Then Enable New Unit Sequence) OR BIOC(CDR-006 Cron Watchdog Re-Enabling Systemd Unit)) — fuses the unit write, the enable sequence, and the cron watchdog from one node into a single persistence incident.
rules.name: Persistence — Node systemd Unit + Self-Healing Cron Watchdog (Same Node)
